Verified dangerous contents of `cache-cleaner.sh`:
- **Line 19** — parent-traversal deletion: `rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR:-/tmp/build}/../"* ` → defaults to deleting `/tmp/*`, or the *parent of any attacker-controlled `BUILD_DIR`* (e.g. `BUILD_DIR=/workspace/x` wipes `/workspace`).

- **Lines 44–46** — `rm -rf "$target"/*`, `rm -rf /home/*/.cache`, `rm -rf /redacted-home/.cache`.
